notes.title: Update Patch v0.7
notes.notes:
This update:
·Fixed an issue where the terrain was out of sync after the save point for the multiplayer client
·Fixed an issue where players other than themselves could not see the flashlight light
·In multiplayer, Smiler kills a player with a chewing sound to indicate that the player has been killed
·Removed Stamina and Sanity (may return in a future version)

Future Updates:
·Rework the next level and add a multiplayer mode to it
·Add more blocks to Level!

notes.title: Update Patch v0.6
notes.notes:
Added custom music features:
How do I use custom music?
Place the sound file in...BackroomsRun For Your LifeBackrooms Run For Your LifeCustomMusic.
Then follow the following format to name it.

BGM_lv1.wav  -----  Level! Background Music
BGM_lv2.wav  -----  Hotel Chase Background Music
BGM_lv3.wav  -----  Level399 Background Music
